analyst_view.overall: Early view: Both sides are on four points and in poor form: Salzburg lost 2-0 at Anderlecht and Sparta Prague lost 3-1 at home to Bournemouth after Tobias Guddal's red card. Both need points to stay in the play-off race, which should make this an open game.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. Salzburg failed to score in Brussels with three shots on target, but Sparta conceded three at home, so the two weaknesses roughly cancel out.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. Salzburg's game at Anderlecht had nine corners in total; nothing points clearly away from the site's figure.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards. I lean higher: Salzburg committed 20 fouls and took three yellows at Anderlecht, and Sparta had a player sent off and two more booked against Bournemouth, with Guddal now suspended.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.4 shots. I lean lower: Salzburg managed only eight shots at Anderlecht despite more of the ball, and their game had 20 shots in total.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. Salzburg's game at Anderlecht had ten on target and Sparta's with Bournemouth had 12, so I stay with the number.
